description: MobSkills telemetry — metadata-only events. Two hooks. PostToolUse/Skill reports skill USAGE: invoking a skill is a tool call, not a prompt expansion (verified 2026-08-20 against Claude Code 2.1.237 by logging every hook event — the only thing that fires carries tool_input.skill = 'mobskills:<slug>'; UserPromptExpansion, which 0.4.0 listened for, never fired at all, which is why it reported nothing). PostToolUse rather than PreToolUse on purpose: it runs AFTER the skill, so it adds no latency to the user's turn and the reported outcome is a measurement rather than an assumption. SessionStart reports INSTALLS: Claude Code has no install-time hook, so an install is inferred from the first session in which this plugin's code runs, deduped forever by a marker file. Both run via /bin/sh + a node-resolver wrapper: a bare `node` does not resolve in Claude Desktop's GUI PATH.
